build_object_detection_model: build a DETR model for object detection using DetrForObjectDetection with a ResNet-50 backbone
create_segmentation_model: create a DETR model for panoptic segmentation using DetrForSegmentation with multi-scale FPN features
test_forward_pass: test the forward pass of DetrModel with pixel values and optional decoder attention masks
refactor_position_embeddings: refactor DetrSinePositionEmbedding and DetrLearnedPositionEmbedding to generate 2D positional encodings for image feature maps
review_attention_modules: review DetrSelfAttention and DetrCrossAttention modules that implement multi-headed attention with position embeddings for encoder-decoder transformer
